items.title: Josiah "Cie" Frazier Interview
items.q: they had a band used to call Ted Lewis, had a record they called Patchy

ctx.x: We were talking about your practicing and I interrupted you. Did you ever practice on drum pads or always on your...

Never practiced on a drum pad in my life. Never did practice on a drum. I used to practice on a drum. I used to practice on a drum. Tables. I've seen drum pads in later years, you know, at different music stores, but I didn't know what that looked like years ago. Oh, I guess so. It used to take sticks or two forks or sometimes beat on a kitchen table. Oh, years ago, like I first said, when we had the old time on Two Row Street, they had a band used to call Ted Lewis, had a record they called Patchy. Oh, yes.
